risk_note: RV2 (linking/**, user authorization boundary; contracts/openapi.yaml only loses the x-implementation: planned line of getUnionAuthUrl, route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated). GET /v1/unions/{platform}/auth-url issues a 600 s single-use state (secure random, no identity in clear, link_id empty, mode bind) for the logged-in user and writes client from the device record, the Taobao auth_methods in configured order (prod filters sdk_token) and server-side auth_app_refs; Pinduoduo gets auth_jump through the open jump matrix (device-record client, installed defaults to unknown) and no auth_methods. A blocked binding of a non-banned user is 30153 first; the site's union authorization of the account actually used (binding's account, else the active self_buy pid's account) being expired gives 30101 / 30102 auth_unavailable without issuing a state. Reads devices / user_risk_state / union_accounts / pids read-only, writes only union_auth_sessions. Written by hand.
